caption: The image is a black-and-white drawing depicting a large, rounded jar with a lid. The jar has a broad body that narrows slightly towards the top, culminating in a short neck with a wide mouth. The lid fits snugly on the jar and features a rounded knob or finial at the top. Both the lid and the neck of the jar are decorated with a repeating pattern of scalloped or wavy lines. The main body of the jar contains engraved or drawn elements, including a botanical design with long, thin stems, leaves, and possibly flowers, as well as some cursive text. The shading and pencil techniques provide depth, suggesting a three-dimensional form and a glazed surface texture. The background is plain and unadorned, focusing all attention on the central jar. The drawing is monochromatic, rendered in shades of gray on light-colored paper, and a faint signature is visible at the lower right corner.
title: Sugar Jar
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
